name: viiibin design system: Modern

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm cream by day, deep ocean at night (the deck's cream and its dark ground).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Flat square cards and panels on the ground (the deck's card on a band).

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Tracks, tiles inside panels, the selected row, a pressed control's fill.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The cool aqua band: one lead surface on a view (Start here, Continue), never more than one.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: rules between rows, panel edges, dividers.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Control edges at rest (fields, outline pills, round buttons) and quiet chart marks: 3:1 or better on ground and panel.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: The ink: body copy, headings and figures. Deep-ocean blue by day, sea-foam at night.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, notes, the label over a reading.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The primary action and the open view: a solid pill in the ink color.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on a primary fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pointed at: hover on links and quiet controls, in the ocean blue. Never a resting state.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, in lagoon (the deck's focus color).

tokens.name: need
tokens.usage: Status NEEDS YOU: what waits on the viewer, with the diamond. Mustard, the deck's small-moment color. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: on-need
tokens.usage: Text on a solid mustard fill (a count badge).

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: The mustard swatch itself: count badges and the one highlight on a lead surface. Text never sits in it on cream.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status ON TRACK, a sea green. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: watch
tokens.usage: Status AT RISK, terracotta. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: fault
tokens.usage: Status BLOCKED and destructive actions, a deep coral red. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Status DONE, APPROVED, VERIFIED, in ocean blue. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: paused
tokens.usage: Status PAUSED and archived work. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: The tint behind a dialog, over the blur (the deck's dialog backdrop).

tokens.name: rail-bg
tokens.usage: The rail capsule: frosted ink by day, a faint light film at night. Variants set it to their own darkest color.

tokens.name: rail-ink
tokens.usage: The icon color of the open view on the rail, on its white fill.

tokens.name: ground-image
tokens.usage: A light wash painted over the ground, fixed to the window (Northlight: a faint dawn in the brand colors).

tokens.name: panel-opacity
tokens.usage: How much of the ground a panel hides: 100% is solid; Northlight’s glass panels let the light through.

tokens.name: panel-shadow
tokens.usage: The shadow under a panel; panels are flat in the Modern system and float softly in Northlight.

tokens.name: sheet-bg
tokens.usage: A dialog’s sheet: frosted ground by default. Northlight makes it a near-solid white tray, so the cream panels on it stand clear.

tokens.name: sheet-edge
tokens.usage: The hairline around a dialog’s sheet.

tokens.name: sheet-shadow
tokens.usage: The shadow that lifts a dialog’s sheet off its veil.

tokens.name: switch-track
tokens.usage: The track behind a pill filter or state switch (the stage filter on Guests, the Blueprint tabs).

tokens.name: switch-on-shadow
tokens.usage: The lift under the chosen pill in a filter or state switch. Northlight raises it like the open view on the rail.

tokens.name: go-fill
tokens.usage: The primary button’s face, inside its edge.

tokens.name: go-border
tokens.usage: The primary button’s edge.

tokens.name: go-ring
tokens.usage: The color stops of a gradient ring around the primary button, drawn through a transparent edge; the ring turns to face the pointer. Transparent where the edge is solid.

tokens.name: go-hover-fill
tokens.usage: The primary button’s face when pointed at.

tokens.name: go-hover-border
tokens.usage: The primary button’s edge when pointed at.

tokens.name: go-glow
tokens.usage: A glow under the primary button when pointed at.

tokens.name: rail-fg
tokens.usage: Rail icons when pointed at.

tokens.name: rail-dim
tokens.usage: Rail icons at rest.

tokens.name: rail-hover
tokens.usage: The rail button’s fill when pointed at.

tokens.name: rail-rule
tokens.usage: The hairlines between the rail’s groups.

tokens.name: rail-border
tokens.usage: The rail capsule’s edge.

tokens.name: rail-on-bg
tokens.usage: The open view’s button on the rail (a CSS background).

tokens.name: rail-on-shadow
tokens.usage: The shadow that raises the open view’s button off the rail; Northlight layers three soft shadows instead of a ring.

tokens.name: rail-tip-bg
tokens.usage: The rail’s tips.

tokens.name: rail-tip-fg
tokens.usage: Text in the rail’s tips.

tokens.name: glow-on
tokens.usage: 1 turns on the ambient light: the edge glow and the cursor aura (Northlight only).

tokens.name: glow-1
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 1 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

tokens.name: glow-2
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 2 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

tokens.name: glow-3
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 3 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

tokens.name: glow-4
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 4 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

tokens.name: glow-5
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 5 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

tokens.name: glow-6
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 6 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

tokens.name: glow-7
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 7 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

tokens.name: glow-8
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 8 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

tokens.name: glow-9
tokens.usage: Ambient light color 9 (the edge glow’s two color rings, read by the shader).

fonts: Newsreader: opsz 6..72, weight 200 to 500, roman and italic (Google Fonts)
DM Sans: opsz 9..40, weight 300 to 600 (Google Fonts)
Each variant loads its own Google Fonts on demand (variants[].fonts)

families.body: 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.label: 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one title on a view or a screen, in Newsreader light (40 px under 700 px). Title case is fine; never bold. Italic marks one word of emphasis.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Six items: four active, one done, one archived.
styles.usage: The sentence under a view's title that says what the view shows right now.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel and card titles, door names at 22 px. Newsreader light.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Metrics, in Newsreader light with lining, tabular numerals (the .figure class). Never bold.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The quiet tracked label: section heads, the label over a reading, the kind over a title, nav links. Uppercase by style, sentence case in the source.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Area codes, IDs and keys, in DM Mono.

styles.name: summary
styles.sample: 7 features wait on the client; building starts when they are decided.
styles.usage: The one-sentence summary that opens a panel, in DM Sans light.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The data migration slipped nine days after the vendor missed the extract window.
styles.usage: Notes, descriptions, decision text. Sentence case.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Secondary lines inside panels and rows.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: IDs, hashes and code only. Figures use Newsreader or the body face with tabular numerals.

styles.name: figure-row
styles.usage: A row's headline figure, tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside tags and between a label and its reading.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows in a panel.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The grid gutter between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, and between groups on a view.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a view's head and its first panel.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The gap between the instrument and its cards.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: The safe frame: the margin between every floating element and the window's edge, written clamp(16px, 3.5vw, 48px).

tokens.name: radius-square
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tiles, fields, tags and tracks: everything that holds content is square (the deck's flat cards).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything you press or that floats: pills, round icon buttons, the header, the rail, the state switch.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only under what floats: the header pill, the rail, a tip. Panels on the ground are flat.

duration.note: From the deck: slow, soft fades. Hover is quick; everything that arrives takes its time.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus: color and fill changes, an arrow's nudge.

tokens.name: dur-arrive
tokens.usage: A view's parts fading in, 80 ms apart.

tokens.name: dur-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog rising 12 px into place while its veil fades in.

tokens.name: dur-leave
tokens.usage: A dialog or a grown card fading out.

tokens.name: dur-fade
tokens.usage: The long cross-fade: a state switch, a lead surface changing what it says.

tokens.name: ease-soft
tokens.usage: Fades: views arriving, cross-fades (the deck's slide fade).

tokens.name: ease-rise
tokens.usage: Dialogs rising, a card growing over its set.

layout.note: Layout lockups: grid compositions more than one view uses. Views read them as var(--layout-<name>).

tokens.name: layout-hub
tokens.usage: A main view: the work in the wide column, Continue and Needs you on the right.

tokens.name: layout-doors
tokens.usage: A row of doors: every card at 230 px or more.

tokens.name: layout-plates
tokens.usage: A screen's panels under its chart.

tokens.name: layout-row
tokens.usage: A status list row: the name, the status word, the arrow.

note: The Modern system (design/modern, October 30, 2026), after a reference proposal deck: a mostly one-color ocean ink on cream, Newsreader light headings, tracked labels, flat square panels, pills for what you press, frosted glass for what floats, slow soft fades. scripts/tokens.ts turns this file into src/styles/tokens.css on every dev start and save. Edit this file, never tokens.css.

shape.note: Shape and voice variables the variants change. Components read them; the defaults are the Modern system.

tokens.name: font-weight-light
tokens.usage: The weight of display titles, figures and other large type (Tailwind font-light).

tokens.name: font-weight-title
tokens.usage: Mid-size titles, 18 to 26 px: panel and card titles, door names, list-row names (the font-title class, type-title). Follows the light weight unless a variant sets it.

tokens.name: font-weight-lead
tokens.usage: The lead sentence under a view's title (.lead, type-statement). Follows the light weight unless a variant sets it.

tokens.name: font-weight-text
tokens.usage: Reading text the system sets light: a panel's summary (type-summary) and notes (the font-text class). Follows the light weight unless a variant sets it.

tokens.name: label-weight
tokens.usage: Weight of the tracked capitals: section heads, labels, chips, nav words, the state switch.

tokens.name: pill-radius
tokens.usage: Buttons and the state switch: a pill here, square in Aman, Kamalaya, Solage and Remedy Place.

tokens.name: pill-pad-x
tokens.usage: A button’s side padding; Aman doubles it.

tokens.name: pill-weight
tokens.usage: Button text weight; Solage and Kamalaya set it bold.

tokens.name: panel-radius
tokens.usage: Panels, fields and dialogs: square here, softly rounded in Six Senses, The Well and Lanserhof.

tokens.name: label-tracking
tokens.usage: Letter spacing of the tracked capitals: labels, nav, buttons.

tokens.name: display-tracking
tokens.usage: Letter spacing of headings.

tokens.name: display-case
tokens.usage: Heading case: uppercase in Golden Door, Kamalaya, SHA and Chenot.

tokens.name: display-style
tokens.usage: Heading style: italic in Lanserhof.

tokens.name: display-scale
tokens.usage: Scales card titles; the variants that set headings in capitals set it below 1 so tracked capitals still fit a card.

variants.note: Northlight, the only look the app wears. It overrides the base tokens: colors (light and dark), font families, the shape variables and some motion.

list.name: Northlight
list.note: A white ground lit by the Northlight sun: soft warm-gray panels with 16 px corners, Inter throughout, from tracked labels to headings, a fine sun-gradient ring on the primary action, the open view raised on layered soft shadows, an edge glow that breathes and swells when the OS acts, and a faint aura that follows the cursor. Night mode is the logo’s violet sky.
list.signature: Cream panels on white and a sun-gradient hairline (#ebc913 → #e77103 → #dc3286 → #8f6ab7 → #8bb1d3), with ambient light at the edges.
